inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Premium beverage commercial, photorealistic, no people. The blue WAVE soda can in <Picture 1> stands upright on a bright seamless studio surface; crystal-clear ice cubes tumble in and settle around its base, cold condensation droplets bead and run down the aluminium, and the camera makes a slow, smooth push-in toward the can.
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to the same WAVE can as a burst of cold water splashes up and around it in slow motion, glittering droplets and a curling sheet of water wrapping the can while the logo stays clearly readable.
[Shot 3] At 00:16.000, the camera cuts to a slow orbit around the same can among ice cubes, the camera circling smoothly as crisp rim light glides across the curved blue aluminium and catches the white WAVE logo and wave graphic.
[Shot 4] At 00:24.000, the camera cuts to a close-up hero shot of the WAVE logo on the can, droplets sliding down, the ice settling and the splash calming, ending on a clean, still final frame of the can centred in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Crisp carbonation fizz, ice cubes clinking against each other and the can, a refreshing slow-motion water splash, droplets pattering, then a soft settling of ice at the end.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat minimal electronic beat with clean synth plucks and a light kick, building gently and resolving on the final hero shot.
